repos_data.description: Use your phone's Face ID or fingerprint to approve sudo and unlock your Mac. QR pairing, encrypted BLE, Secure Enclave signing — keys never leave your phone. Works with iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, or any browser. No $199 Magic Keyboard needed.
Cover your Mac screen with a hotkey while AI agents keep running. Dog/cat mascot, native Settings, Touch ID unlock.
The privacy-first menu bar manager for macOS. Now 100% free and open source (MIT) — every feature unlocked. Native, lightweight, and scriptable.
A free, open-source macOS window manager. Magnet-compatible keyboard shortcuts + drag-snap.
Anti-forensic macOS tray application designed to safeguard your system by monitoring USB ports.
Your Mac as a key fob: SSH keys that live in the Secure Enclave, open only the doors they're badged for, and take one touch to use.
Very simple swift wrapper for Biometric Authentication Services (Touch ID) on iOS.
Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system cache cleanup. MIT licensed.

DockAnchor is a simple macOS utility that stops the Dock from moving between displays. Lock your Dock to a single screen for a more stable, distraction-free workspace. Ideal for multi-monitor setups. Lightweight, native, and runs quietly in the background.
A Dimness and Night Shift menu bar app for macOS 🌙

repo_meta_data.description: Free, open-source macOS app that locks applications with Touch ID, Apple Watch, and trusted Wi-Fi. The only open-source app locker for macOS.
